function.name: retrieve_context
function.description: Retrieve global reference context from the user's stored state. Once per session, before planning.

function.name: plan_session
function.description: Create and validate ten scenes and two music plans using retrieved context. Also attaches per-scene references. Once per session.

function.name: start_music
function.description: Start both planned music requests in background threads. Call early after planning so music overlaps GPU work. Idempotent.

function.name: generate_scenes
function.description: Generate initial images for selected not-yet-generated scene IDs and repair panorama seams. Batch eligible IDs to minimize overhead.

function.name: audit_scenes
function.description: Measure and visually audit selected generated, not-yet-audited candidates. Audit is mandatory before refine/finalize.

function.name: refine_scenes
function.description: For failed audited scenes with remaining retries, re-retrieve, rewrite prompts, regenerate and repair seams. Requires subsequent audit.

function.name: inspect_session
function.description: Read authoritative progress, failures and available actions without changing state.

function.name: finish_session
function.description: Save best audited candidates, enhance final images, await music, export Unity-compatible JSON. All scenes must be terminal: passed, generation failed, or retry budget exhausted.
